Difficulty.title: Difficulty profile
Difficulty.intro: Six axes, from 0 to 4. Every value sits next to the fact that justifies it.

definitions.scope: How many heterogeneous pieces, and how many boundaries to cross.
definitions.coupling: How many parties have to agree, human parties included.
definitions.stakes: What actually breaks when something goes wrong.
definitions.conformance: Whether an outside reference has to be matched exactly: a specification, a standard, the behaviour of another program.
definitions.rules: How many cases, exceptions and nested conditions.
definitions.disciplines: How many trades are carried in the same project: design, code, content, tooling.

levels.2: A few, with no interaction between them
levels.4: Many, nested, and an error propagates

Difficulty.floor: The floor of the hexagon is not zero: a vertex at the centre would erase the shape. The dotted ring marks zero, and the numeric value is always shown.
